name: SprayApplicationRecordManager
tagline: Spray diary, PHI/REI field status and label compliance in one plug-and-play Power Apps component.
description: Plan spray jobs, approve them against the product label, record the application with operator, sprayer and weather, verify independently and see which fields are under a re-entry or withholding period – in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: PHI and REI tracking with harvest-safe and re-entry dates
Label maximum rate and season application limit checks (block or warn)
Wind and temperature limits at application
Tank mix sheet for your tank size
Bulk approve / verify / cancel with undo
Search, quick filters, filters drawer, group, sort, paging
Demo mode with fictional sample data
controlType: standard (dataset control + SprayApplicationRecordManagerPortal field control from one project)
